Now, the right square is stuck at (39, 44). I need to figure out how to free it or if the goal only involves the left square.
Let me try SPACE to see if it does anything now that the left square is at the top.
Actually, wait. Let me reconsider the puzzle. Maybe the goal is to get the left square to the top AND the right square to some position. Or maybe the goal is to get both squares to the same row.
But the right square is stuck. Let me try moving it with different commands.
Actually, I realize the right square moved when I pressed LEFT earlier (from col 39 to col 44). But when I pressed RIGHT, it didn't move. This is strange because RIGHT should move the right square left (opposite direction).
Wait, let me re-check. After RIGHT:
- Left square: (19, 19) - moved from (19, 14) to (19, 19), right by 5
- Right square: (39, 44) - stayed at (39, 44)
So RIGHT moved the left square right but didn't move the right square. This suggests the right square is blocked from moving left.
And earlier, LEFT moved the right square right (from col 39 to col 44). So the right square can move right but not left. This makes sense if there's a wall to the left of the right square.
But the right square is at col 44, and to its left (cols 39-43) is orange corridor. So there should be space to move left. Unless the square is blocked by something else.
Actually, looking at the ascii for the right side:
- Row 39: OOOOOOOOOOOBBBBBBBBB
- Cols 33-43: OOOOOOOOOOO (orange)
- Cols 44-52: BBBBBBBBB (black)
The right square is at cols 44-48 (black area). To move left, it would need cols 39-43 to be clear, which they are (orange). But the square didn't move left when I pressed RIGHT.
Hmm, maybe the square can only move if the destination is the same color as the current position. The square is on black cells, and to its left is orange cells. So it can't move left because the color changes.
But earlier, the square was on orange cells (cols 39-43) and moved right to black cells (cols 44-48). So it CAN move from orange to black. But it can't move from black to orange?
This is confusing. Let me just try SPACE and see what happens.
